question.en: Discuss the role of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) in global climate governance and its relevance to the Indian economy.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO) in global climate governance and its relevance to the Indian economy.

modelAnswer.en: WMO provides standardized climate data, early warning systems for disasters, and supports agricultural resilience. For India, this is crucial for monsoon forecasting, disaster management, and food security.
